snippet.title: Sonic Unleashed 3DS - Apotos Preview Release
snippet.description:
Go play the preview at SAGE !
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-unleashed-3ds-apotos-demo.2738
Important message here, you certainly notice that the name of the demo changed and the release was a bit delayed. The deadlines was way too short so half of what i've planned with this could not be done. It's quite glitchy and all but i couldn't let you with nothing (even if i'm not really proud). These last two weeks have really tired me out, i'm taking a HUUUUUGE break, and i won't schedule deadline anymore for next releases. If it's not good yet, it only mean that it can be only better. Thanks

You want to know more ? Check Sonic Unleashed 3DS on :
Discord : https://discord.com/invite/URysmgnBYt
Gamejolt : https://gamejolt.com/games/unleashed-3ds/795748
